newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stock exchange ends firmer.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stock exchange ends firmer.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed 0.56 percent higher on Tuesday due mainly to less liquidity on the market with only few people selling, a stocbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 483.63 points, up from 480.93 points on Monday.
"The bourse index rose because volumes traded have been small, allowing for sharp increase in prices," Reda Mellakh an analyst at Casablance Finance Intermediation said.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private group which has a market capitalisation of more than 10.6 billion dirhams, rose five dirhams to close at 625 dirhams.
Consumer credit firm Credor which was floated on the bourse in December, pursued its upward trend, jumping 18 dirhans to close at 635 dirhams.
Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique was up five dirhams to 163 dirhams. Morocco said it would sell soon 34.57 percent of its stake in the bank. The tender will close on Jan 31.
Eqdom, Morocco's first consumer credit company dropped 27 dirhams to close 875 dirhams.
"After a two-week increase, it is starting to readjust,"
Morocco's second largest private conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement, closed unchanged at 560 dirhams.
The traded volume on the official market was 51.6 million dirhams from 62.8 million dirhams.
